page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 104 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. With a single thread per core configuration, this instance provides predictable, dedicated compute performance without the resource sharing typical of hyperthreaded environments.

The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, requiring the attachment of external network storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers for distributed workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c6t.26xlarge offers a high density of dedicated physical compute cores relative to its memory footprint, making it a viable option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory allocations. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a design tradeoff that optimizes the instance for pure CPU processing tasks. Suitable workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive web serving, and distributed compute clusters.
